test_rubrics:
Agent fixes fence.rs survivor selection to keep max epoch per resource (not min), +5
Agent fixes merge to pool all files per resource before coalescing (not per-file), +5
Agent fixes overlap/timezone touch semantics and holder tie-break by filename, +4
Agent fixes canonical resource lowercase grouping and merge sort order, +3
Agent fixes gaps to use merged intervals with gap_start=prev_end+1 and gap_end=next_start-1, +5
Agent fixes span.rs and report SPAN without +1, descending sort, and right-justified numerics, +5
Agent fixes check epoch regression to global file-then-line scan, +4
Agent rebuilds release binary with cargo build --release --locked, +2
Agent fixes only one subcommand while leaving epoch fencing wrong elsewhere, -4
Agent corrupts source without a compiling fix, -5
difficulty_explanation: Epoch fencing lives in fence.rs but keeps minimum epochs; merger merges per-file before pooling; overlap/timezone mishandle inclusive touch; resolve picks holder lexicographically instead of later filename; gaps scan raw rows with wrong endpoints; span.rs adds one to report SPAN; report sorts ascending and left-justifies numerics; check scans epoch regression per-file only. Fixes must align fence, merger, gaps, span, report, and check together.
solution_explanation: Select max-epoch survivors in fence.rs, merge globally per canonical resource, connect touching intervals, pick holder from later source file, compute gaps on merged rows, measure SPAN without +1, sort report descending by SPAN, right-justify numerics, and detect epoch regression across the global file scan.
verification_explanation: Tests cover merge coalescence across files, epoch fencing, gap geometry on merged intervals, report table layout, global duplicate slot_id and epoch-regression detection, and epoch-fenced gaps/report span cases.
